args.query: generate presigned S3 upload URL with AWS SDK v3 in Node

results.title: AWS SDK v3 S3 storage helpers tested with aws-sdk-client-mock
results.summary: S3 helpers on @aws-sdk/client-s3 for JSON put/get with NoSuchKey handling, paginated listing, batched DeleteObjects and locally signed presigned URLs, tested offline with aws-sdk-client-mock and sdkStreamMixin bodies.

results.title: boto3 S3 helper with paginated listing and presigned URLs, tested offline with moto
results.summary: A small boto3 S3 helper for upload, paginated listing, presigned GET URLs and batched delete, tested offline with moto's mock_aws and fake credentials.

results.title: AWS SDK v3 DynamoDB document client and SQS events, tested with Vitest matchers
results.summary: A single-table DynamoDB order service on @aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb with conditional puts, begins_with queries and optimistic locking, publishing SQS events, tested offline with aws-sdk-client-mock and aws-sdk-client-mock-vitest matchers.

results.title: Fastify 5 file uploads with @fastify/multipart
results.summary: Accept multipart file uploads in Fastify 5 with @fastify/multipart, reading fields and files, hashing content, rejecting oversized files with 413, tested with inject() and a native FormData body.

results.title: python-slugify + text-unidecode multilingual URL slugs
results.summary: Turn accented, Cyrillic and CJK titles into URL slugs with python-slugify, using text-unidecode for ASCII romanization or allow_unicode to keep scripts verbatim, then dedupe collisions.

results.title: slugify URL and filesystem path helpers
results.summary: Build stable URL slugs and unique path segments with slugify, covering custom replacements, lowercase, and collision suffixes offline.

results.title: MCP server with in-memory tools
results.summary: Build an McpServer from @modelcontextprotocol/sdk that registers two zod-typed tools and one resource, then exercise it offline through a Client linked by InMemoryTransport.createLinkedPair().

results.title: Anthropic TypeScript SDK tool use loop, tested with a mocked fetch
results.summary: Run a Claude tool_use loop with the official Anthropic SDK and Zod-validated tool inputs, tested offline with an injected fetch.

results.title: Anthropic SDK message streaming with text deltas, tested with a mocked SSE fetch
results.summary: Stream Claude responses with the Anthropic TypeScript SDK (messages.stream, text events, finalMessage), tested offline with a fake fetch returning Anthropic SSE events.

results.title: boto3 DynamoDB idempotency and SQS queue tested offline with moto
results.summary: A DynamoDB conditional put for idempotent writes plus SQS send and receive, tested offline with moto mock_aws and fake credentials.
